title: Low-Energy Quantum Effective Action for Relativistic Superfluids
preprocessing_note: No local paper copy is used by the verifier. The record locks source identity and conceptual role only.

formula_locators.role: external support for deriving the ideal Goldstone sector from P(X), not a UET derivation

claim_boundary: The source supports the general P(X) low-energy organization of a relativistic superfluid Goldstone mode.
It does not derive the UET O(2) potential, response coupling, equation-of-state parameters, or transport coefficients.
